text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho is finally here!
It's the final G1 race of the Tiara line.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder who's gonna win this one?
Hishi Amazon, for sure?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I heard rumors that you trained a ton over the summer.
I can't wait to see!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's hearts danced with excitement for the
fierce battle to come.
Meanwhile, back in the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Brian, who staged an overwhelming victory at the Japan Derby.
Is a Kikuka Sho triumph guaranteed—?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha! Man, that's some serious hype!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but it's not entirely wrong, is it?!
Who knows, maybe I'll set another record!
Ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...No, she really might do it. Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, I'm all fired up! I'm doing this too!
Gonna go warm up real quick!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she lifted the bag,
something fluttered out and fell to the floor.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mm? What's this?
...A letter?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mmm~? What's this, what's this...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "—'I can't wait to see your ultimate run, Big Sis. Leave 'em all in the dust!'"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"We enclosed big sis's favorite licorice candy.
We're all cheering for you!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...What the? When did they even set all this up?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon picked up a piece
of licorice candy and tossed it into her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's delicious.
It has a nostalgic taste.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Yeah, you're right. Those guys are watching too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final showdown of the Tiara route,
the Shuka Sho, begins right now—!
